groups.group: Manaksia group (pre-2013 single group; now four listed companies)
groups.decision_office: Kolkata; each listed company has its own board
groups.control_summary: Until 2013 one listed company, Manaksia Ltd, with large holders Basudeo Agrawal (12.55%), Suresh Kumar Agrawal, Mahabir Prasad Agrawal and Basant Kumar Agrawal (MD) [fact, FY13 annual report]. The court-approved scheme (appointed date 1 Oct 2013) moved aluminium, steel, packaging and coated-metal/mosquito-coil undertakings into separate companies. Each company now sits with one family line [fact, FY26 annual reports]: Manaksia Ltd and Manaksia Steels with the Suresh Kumar Agrawal / Basudeo Agrawal line (brothers; Suresh's son Varun); Manaksia Coated Metals with Sushil Kumar Agrawal and sons Karan and Tushar; Manaksia Aluminium with Sunil Kumar Agrawal and son Anirudha. Sushil's disclosed relatives include Mahabir Prasad Agrawal, Kanta Devi Agrawal and Sunil Kumar Agrawal, so Sushil and Sunil appear to be one sub-branch under Mahabir Prasad [interpretation]. Manaksia Industries (packaging, mosquito coil) went to Basant Kumar Agrawal [reported].

An independent analyst reported it among related parties in earlier years (not checked). Kinship between S.C. Agarwalla and B.K. Agarwalla is not established.

links.from_group: Patni group (Ankit Metal, Impex Ferro Tech, Rohit Ferro-Tech)
links.description: Impex Metal & Ferro Alloys (Bobbili, Andhra Pradesh) was acquired by Maithan Alloys and merged. The Maithan filing confirms the merger; that Impex Metal belonged to the Patni group comes from the input list.

Both are Beriwala families. A company submission for environmental clearance states that Brij Mohan Beriwala (SRMB) 'has a family background and associated with steel business Shyam Steel Industries'. The exact kinship of Radha Kishan Beriwala to Shriram / Shyam Sunder Beriwala is not stated.

Inside Shyam Steel, ownership is split about 58:42 between Shyam Sunder Beriwala's sons (Group A) and Shriram Beriwala's sons (Group B). Reported from DRHP and notices via search; documents not opened.
No link found. Same 'Shyam' brand word, but different surnames (Agarwal vs Beriwala) and no related-party entries.

Skipper names the late Sadhuram Bansal as its founder, and a 1984 Supreme Court record shows Sajan Kumar Bansal acting as his son. BMW's Ram Gopal, Harsh and Vivek Bansal are directors of 'Sadhuram Bansal & Sons Ltd'. This points to shared ancestry (possibly Ram Gopal and Sajan as brothers), but no filing states it and neither annual report lists the other as a related party.
Supershakti Metaliks and Sai Electrocasting demerged from Super Smelters in Aug 2016. Supershakti buys sponge iron from SSL and Giridhan, holds ~21% of Giridhan and lends to it.

Possible overlap only. Gagan Ferrotech was co-founded by Deepak Agarwal and Vinay Kumar Agarwal (friends; Deepak exited). Shakambhari's lead promoter is also a Deepak Agarwal, and a Gagan company is called 'Shakambhari Overseas Trades'. No source says they are the same person; the rating agency treats Shakambhari Overseas as part of Gagan, not Shakambhari. Super Smelters also has a Deepak Kumar Agarwal (son of Sitaram). Treat as unresolved name collision.
Neo Metaliks is owned by the Rupa & Co hosiery family (P.R., K.B., G.P. Agarwal), not a separate steel family. Earlier JV with the Madhogaria family (exited FY05).

Brij Kishore/Rajeev branch and Basant Kumar/Prashant branch (brothers, then cousins) held equal ~25.5% under a 2009 shareholders' agreement. Feud since 2017: Prashant removed as chairman (2017), Basant voted off (2019), petitions before High Court and NCLT. Basant/Prashant side selling down via Peterhouse entities.
Usha Martin's steel business (Jamshedpur) sold to Tata Steel (via Tata Sponge Iron) in 2019. Both family branches voted for it.
Electrosteel Steels (Bokaro), promoted by Electrosteel Castings (45.23% stake in 2014), went through insolvency. Vedanta took ~90% in June 2018 for about Rs 5,320 crore; now ESL Steel.
B.C. Jindal was a brother of O.P. Jindal. Separate groups since the founding generation; no cross-holding known.
